settings.base_url.label: CLIProxyAPI URL
settings.base_url.description: Base URL of the proxy, without the /v8/management path.
settings.key_file.label: Management key file
settings.key_file.description: File holding the plaintext management key (remote-management.secret-key before hashing).
settings.refresh_seconds.label: Refresh seconds
settings.refresh_seconds.description: Seconds between reads of the proxy's routing overview.
settings.usage_display.label: Show quota as
settings.usage_display.description: Show the used or the remaining share. Colors always follow consumption.
settings.show_disabled.label: Show disabled accounts
settings.show_disabled.description: List accounts disabled in CLIProxyAPI in the panel, dimmed. They never count toward the pooled reading.
settings.providers.label: Providers
settings.providers.description: Provider ids to show, such as claude or codex. Empty shows every provider with quota data.
settings.show_value.label: Show percentage
settings.show_gauge.label: Show gauge
settings.show_gauge.description: Short window above a thinner long-window bar.
settings.show_countdown.label: Show reset countdown
tooltip.no_data: No quota data from CLIProxyAPI yet
error.no_key: No management key: write it to the key file in the plugin settings
error.auth: CLIProxyAPI rejected the management key. Polling paused; fix the key, then refresh
